card.line: Baal-shalishah was a city in Israel. A man from there brought Elisha bread from the first ripe grain, and God used it to feed a hundred men.

moments.title: Bread for a hundred men
moments.text: A man from Baal-shalishah brought Elisha twenty loaves of barley bread from the first ripe grain. Elisha said to give it to the people, and by the word of the LORD they all ate and had some left over.
